trajectory.patch:
The Kconfig warning indicates that `CONFIG_MAX_THREAD_BYTES` is being set in a configuration where its dependency, `CONFIG_USERSPACE`, is not met. This happens because the `tests/kernel/mutex/sys_mutex` test is built for configurations both with and without userspace enabled. When userspace is disabled, `CONFIG_MAX_THREAD_BYTES` is not a valid Kconfig symbol, but the project configuration files still attempt to set it, causing the warning.

The fix is to make the assignment of `CONFIG_MAX_THREAD_BYTES` conditional on `CONFIG_TEST_USERSPACE`, which is only enabled when `CONFIG_USERSPACE` is also enabled. This ensures the option is only set in valid configurations.

tests/kernel/mutex/sys_mutex/boards/pocketbeagle_2_am6254_a53.conf
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
CONFIG_MAX_THREAD_BYTES=3
========
if TEST_USERSPACE
CONFIG_MAX_THREAD_BYTES=3
endif
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
tests/kernel/mutex/sys_mutex/prj.conf
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
CONFIG_MAX_THREAD_BYTES=8
========
if TEST_USERSPACE
CONFIG_MAX_THREAD_BYTES=8
endif
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
